# gitmoap_group_label (Resource)

Adds a label to the group's vocabulary: a key, a colour and an optional description. Work items in the group and in every repository beneath it can carry it. A key written `scope::name` makes the label scoped, and a work item carries at most one label per scope. Maintainers and above may define labels; a key the group already defines is refused, as is a new label once the group is at its label limit.

The token needs `label:manage` and `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "platform" {
  full_path = "acme/platform"
}

resource "gitmoap_group_label" "bug" {
  group_id    = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.platform.group_id
  key         = "bug"
  color       = "#d73a4a"
  description = "Something isn't working"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String)
- `group_id` (String) Group ID
- `key` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `title` (String) Its display name, 1–64 characters; without one it shows its key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id and key, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_group_label.example "<group_id>/<key>"
```
